sourceText:
Quiche Without Crust
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 20, 2009 - 12:06am

Ingredients




3 cups what have you (cooked grains, crumbled tofu, cottage c
Seasonings to taste (tamari, yeast, garlic)
1/2 cup milk
1 cup grated cheddar or Jack cheese
3 beaten eggs
Daily supplements as recommended

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients except milk, cheese and eggs in a medium size casserole dish. Scald milk in saucepan, then stir in cheese until melted. Add eggs to milk/cheese mixture and pour over rest of casserole. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until firm. Supplements may be pre-mixed into casserole or mashed in when serving your pet.
